items.title: FLUX
items.description: ABOUT:Through our daily lives, we navigate a vast spectrum of emotions - some move with a slow, steady pulse, while others arrive with swift, unpredictable energy. They can be gentle whispers or intense surges - some remain stable for a lifetime, while others are as fleeting as a breath, fluid and ever-changing. This photographic series of water sculptures seek to capture some of these momentary, transient states. Like the emotions they mirror, these colorful and oddly shaped bubbles are fragile structures of light and surface tension, existing for just a few seconds before vanishing. They can serve as visual metaphors for the human psyche?shaping and reflecting the unique complexities of our personalities. ???????TECHNICAL: This work is pure photography - the bubbles are real. Processing limited to foundational contrast and tonal adjustments to reproduce the scene. The images contains no elements of computer-generated imagery (CGI), artificial intelligence (AI), or any other form.

items.title: UAPC - illustration and branding
items.description: UAPC it's a cool moment in Pistoia City where the city center become a sort of new green park in town. UAPC means "un altro parco in città" the idea it's to create something really basic but open to future. Every letter become larger like an empty space where you could plant new idea. I'm starting with my draw but every year this space will be open to new sign! And what happen to my illustration?? In the night we went all around city adding green sign with spry and marker on all poster! Like grass everything change and tell different story to reader.

items.title: Disney+ Percy Jackson & the Olympians | Season 2
items.description: I had the pleasure of returning to Percy Jackson and the Olympians as Lead Illustrator for the Season 2 main-on-end title sequence, collaborating once again with the talented team at Imaginary Forces. Inspired by the Art Deco influences of Season 1, this new chapter dives into the Sea of Monsters, bringing Greek mythology to life through a maritime-inspired world of mythical creatures, ancient symbols and epic oceanic landscapes.

items.title: Barcelona Pattern Flower
items.description: A collection of floral patterns and motifs inspired by the flowers of Barcelona. Exploring shapes, colors, and organic forms, this series translates the city's botanical beauty into a contemporary visual language through illustration and surface pattern design. Original Work by Pablo Ferreira - losdibujitosdepablo

items.title: Hervanta series
items.description: In the midst of the uniform concrete apartment blocks of Hervanta, Finnish architects Raili and Reima Pietilä created an expressive counterpoint: the Hervanta Central Axis (Hervannan keskusakseli). Built in two phases in 1979 and 1989, this red-brick complex?comprising a community center, church, and library?forms the social and sculptural heart of the district. Focusing on the organic, jagged brick facades, deep arcades, and dramatic roof lines that break away from classic functionalism. Exploring how the Nordic light interacts with the rough texture and warm tones of the red brick. The series was taken in July 2026. items.title: Orange House
items.description: Orange House is a private retreat in Sokcho, Gangwon-do, operated by xyz. The rebranding project focused on refining its brand identity through a redesigned symbol and wordmark, enhancing visual applications across online and offline touchpoints, and developing a cohesive signage system to create a consistent brand experience throughout the space.
